ledger.x: 1958: the rebels hold the Sierra Maestra.
July 1958: Batista's summer offensive reaches the heart of the Sierra Maestra.
December 1958: the rebel columns attack Santa Clara.
31 December 1958: the Battle of Santa Clara.
1 January 1959: Batista flees and the rebels take the state.

wars.name: Cuban Revolution
wars.outcome: Rebel victory: Batista fled on 1 January 1959 and Castro reached Havana on 8 January.

wars.name: Operation Verano
wars.outcome: Government failure: the Battle of El Jigüe (11 to 21 July 1958) was a 'turning point'; Las Mercedes (29 July–8 August) was the last battle and 'Castro's entire army had escaped back into the mountains' by 8 August.

certainty.note: A mountain zone held by guerrillas with no line on the ground; the outline is Cliopatria's approximation.
